notes: All 14 relevant super-bowler source playbooks were read. Queen charge/recall is the plurality opening in six videos: 4TGHrJl3h1s, KkXmRkx20x4, NC_E4SvSb_E, gWXxU_sp7Kg, h-6DBh45ozk and qqdSRPKkDVY. Dragon Duke charge appears in three and Royal Champion charge in four, with QH4OIrEePh4 describing both alternatives.

No complete composition repeats verbatim. The default is the gWXxU_sp7Kg roster: its troops match 4TGHrJl3h1s, its home spells match NC_E4SvSb_E, and its complete loadouts match both. Five Super Bowlers are specified by six videos versus six by three. Unknown quantities are not zero. Siege inventory entries are alternatives; only Sky Wagon is selected here.

Support counts distinct videos describing an action or rule, not replays or duplicated policies. Counts describe the shared action and purpose; sources differ on quantities, exact conditions and ordering. Quotes and timestamps are copied from source records using verified_t.

Every delay of 0 represents an unspecified delay. It does not establish that the funnel has finished. inside:Archer Queen approximates obtaining the required charge value before Recall; inside:Royal Champion and inside:Dragon Duke approximate establishing their alternate funnels. The vocabulary cannot test cleared funnel buildings, absence of defending troops, or spell-effect expiry.

The scouting Balloon precedes Healers as in h-6DBh45ozk; 4TGHrJl3h1s instead says Queen, Healers, test Balloon. The Ice Golem's heavy_fire trigger approximates initial damage protection; its position relative to wall opening varies. One Ice Golem remains for the main push.

Charge Rage is conditional in four sources. h-6DBh45ozk explicitly reserves Rage for Bowlers and uses Invisibility/Totem instead. Only one conditional Invisibility cast is encoded because Queen sources give no fixed repeat interval. Additional situational casts are described, but no interval is invented.

Recall uses what:Recall Spell so the executor can cast it, with the Queen as the anchor. h-6DBh45ozk explicitly recalls Queen and Healers. Other sources do not consistently identify the supporting troops captured. Redeployment returns the recalled group; Healers not recalled have no invented second deployment.

Source charge-duration advice conflicts: NC_E4SvSb_E recommends around 45 seconds, around 40 when time is a problem, and sometimes a minute; 4TGHrJl3h1s recommends about a minute, extending to 1:15 only when confident. No universal charge duration is imposed.

Duke-before-King follows KkXmRkx20x4 and h-6DBh45ozk; other sources reverse or overlap them with the main deployment. edge:funnel cannot express separate inner Duke and wider outside King lanes. Utility troops use all remaining quantities from the selected roster, not newly inferred narration counts.

group_inside:main approximates reaching the core, and heavy_fire:Super Bowler approximates significant danger. These cannot enforce clearing the outside funnel or defending Clan Castle before Torch. Sources warn against premature Torch; some demonstrations activate around Clan Castle engagement.

rage_entry and rage_torch represent the separate entry and Torch Rages explicitly described in QH4OIrEePh4. Their separation is unstated and the triggers can coincide. No Rage repeat interval is invented. unit_ahead:Super Bowler approximates gWXxU_sp7Kg's forward placement.

The two Poison steps share the single available spell. defenders anchors cannot prioritize Furnace separately from other defenders or distinguish enemy heroes for Headhunters. threat:main approximates named Freeze/Totem targets and cannot enforce a multi-defense Freeze or the corrected Totem position behind the defense.

King ability after deployment follows h-6DBh45ozk's immediate funnel example; other sources use it while funneling or correcting Bowler drift. Queen ability and cleanup Archers after Warden are zero-delay approximations for otherwise unspecified main-push and late-cleanup timing. Most exact placement tiles are unspoken.

Royal Champion variant requires an army/loadout change before execution; the required variant schema has no army override. Replace King with Royal Champion for the Queen/Duke/Warden composition. QH4OIrEePh4's charging RC uses Electro Boots/Haste Vial/Spirit Fox and its supporting Duke uses Fire Heart/Stun Blaster. P6twlQY3fLk and yI1ZdPZswNM instead give Rocket Spear examples. yI1ZdPZswNM uses King and no Queen, a distinct minority lineup. Queen-shot steps require Giant Arrow, as named in P6twlQY3fLk, rather than the default Monolith Arrow. QH4OIrEePh4's counted preset provides six Bowlers and five Invisibility Spells; other RC armies are partially stated.

Royal Champion ability timing conflicts: immediate in yI1ZdPZswNM, low health or immediate in different P6twlQY3fLk examples, and held for the main army in _N5VEy9FTN0. No universal RC ability step or invented HP threshold is selected. Recall is explicit in P6twlQY3fLk but not every RC replay, so it is not required in the shared variant.

P6twlQY3fLk states Invisibility casts at attack-clock 2:56, 2:46, 2:36 and so on. QH4OIrEePh4 describes alternating with Spirit Fox and possible double cycling; _N5VEy9FTN0 delays its first cast. The shared RC variant therefore encodes one conditional cast and does not impose a universal cadence.

Dragon Duke charge needs Electro Fangs/Fire Heart instead of the default support loadout: 4HmRoonPBIU uses Spirit Fox, QH4OIrEePh4 uses Angry Jelly. The heavy_fire ability trigger after Invisibility is the closest proxy for needing his health regeneration after protection ends; it can activate too early because spell expiry is unavailable. Only one conditional cast is encoded; no universal interval is established. The variant retains King/Queen support from 4HmRoonPBIU and Lp0_1GWln48 rather than QH4OIrEePh4's Queen/RC counter funnel. Both counted Duke-charge rosters use six Bowlers and five Invisibility Spells; the default five-Bowler/two-Invisibility inventory is not their preset.

For siege variants, replace Sky Wagon in cc with the selected machine. KkXmRkx20x4 prefers Sky Wagon against Lava Launcher and gradual Troop Launcher progress when that threat is absent. Exact siege deployment times are often unstated; zero delays approximate deployment during the main push.

The Rocket Backpack/Flame Blower variant requires those Duke equipment pieces and Phoenix as in yxVyP7vPQPw. It replaces only the Duke's funnel ability call; that video's unspoken main deployment order is not reconstructed. Its Earthquake/Town Hall entry, Skeleton activation of the Invisibility Tower and Tesla-clearing Yeti remain source-specific options rather than invented complete openings.

Other composition: 4HmRoonPBIU has 6 Bowlers, 5 Healers, 2 Ice Golems, 2 Archers, 2 Super Wall Breakers, 2 Balloons, 1 Baby Dragon, 1 Apprentice Warden, 2 Headhunters and 1 Minion; home spells are 2 Rage, 2 Totem and 5 Invisibility, with 2 donated Revive. Queen uses Action Figure/Magic Mirror/Diggy.

Other composition: 4TGHrJl3h1s has the default troops but 3 Rage, 1 Freeze, 3 Invisibility and 1 Poison. KkXmRkx20x4 has 5 Bowlers, 5 Healers, 2 Ice Golems, 3 Balloons, 3 Super Wall Breakers, 2 Valkyries, 1 Wizard, 1 Archer, 1 Baby Dragon, 1 Apprentice Warden, 1 Headhunter, 2 Wall Breakers and 1 Minion; home spells are 3 Rage, 2 Invisibility, 1 Freeze and 2 Totem, with donated Poison, Skeleton and Recall. Its Duke has Stun Blaster/Electro Fangs/Spirit Fox and its narrated siege is Troop Launcher.

Other composition: NC_E4SvSb_E differs from the default with 2 Archers, 3 Wizards, 4 Balloons and 1 Valkyrie; its cc has Balloon, Ice Golem and Super Yeti plus Recall and 2 Totem. It narrates Log Launcher. 6FVZHuESY4g and Lp0_1GWln48 give no complete counted army.

Other composition: QH4OIrEePh4 has 6 Bowlers, 5 Healers, 2 Balloons, 2 Super Wall Breakers, 1 Apprentice Warden, 2 Ice Golems, 2 Headhunters and 1 Minion; home spells are 5 Invisibility, 1 Revive, 1 Overgrowth and 1 Rage, with donated Rage/Totem and Sky Wagon/Super Yeti/Super Valkyrie. Its heroes are Queen/Duke/RC/Warden; Queen has Giant Arrow/Action Figure/Frosty. Its TH16 preset has 5 Bowlers plus Baby Dragon; its TH18 preset exchanges home Rage for 2 Totem and donates 2 Rage.

Other composition: P6twlQY3fLk and _N5VEy9FTN0 give partial RC armies with 5 Invisibility and mostly unknown other quantities. P6twlQY3fLk specifies 2 Ice Golems; _N5VEy9FTN0 names Sky Wagon and its TH17 account lacks its introduced Frost Flake. yI1ZdPZswNM specifies 6 Bowlers and 2 Ice Golems, uses RC/Duke/King/Warden, leaves most other quantities unknown, and does not identify its siege or attacking cc.

Other composition: h-6DBh45ozk has 5 Bowlers, 5 Healers, 3 Balloons, 3 Super Wall Breakers, 2 Ice Golems, 1 Apprentice Warden, 1 Baby Dragon, 1 Headhunter, 1 Valkyrie, 2 Minions and 3 Archers; home spells are 3 Invisibility, 2 Rage, 1 Poison, 1 Freeze and 2 Totem. Donated contents are 1 Balloon, 2 Ice Golems, 1 Super Valkyrie, Skeleton and Recall; hero loadouts are partial.

Other composition: qqdSRPKkDVY specifies 3 Archers, 1 Baby Dragon, 2 Valkyries, 2 Ice Golems, 1 Apprentice Warden, 2 Rage and 3 Invisibility; most other quantities and attacking cc are unknown. Duke equipment discussion is ambiguous between Fire Heart and Stun Blaster, and Phoenix is named.

Other composition: yxVyP7vPQPw has 5 Bowlers, 5 Healers, 1 Ice Golem, 2 Archers, 2 Super Wall Breakers, 1 Balloon, 2 Wizards, 1 Baby Dragon, 1 Apprentice Warden, 1 Electro Titan, 1 Headhunter and 1 Yeti; home spells are 3 Rage, 2 Totem, 1 Invisibility, 1 Earthquake and 1 Skeleton, with 2 donated Freeze and 1 Revive. Duke has Rocket Backpack/Flame Blower/Phoenix; Queen has Action Figure/Magic Mirror/Diggy.

Revive and Overgrowth are absent from the default composition. Sources describe reviving Duke, with _N5VEy9FTN0 allowing RC if Duke survives, and QH4OIrEePh4 describes Overgrowth for path control while warning against splits. These need their source-specific spell inventories. Ambiguous defense names such as logger, cake, candle and long shot are not assigned unsupported in-game identities.
No unambiguous shared siege release timing is provided, so no release_siege step is invented. No synthetic performance or real-game calibration claim is made.
